card.name: Space before number of treatment cycles
card.fires_on: The blank space after "for" or "for up to" just before a number of cycles or weeks, in dosing schedules for chemotherapy combinations.

modes.label: Duration of combination chemotherapy
modes.description: Space after "for" or "for up to" in a schedule where a drug is given with chemotherapy, right before a count of cycles or weeks.
